description: Get the latest-day net ETF inflow/outflow (USD millions) for every tracked crypto asset: BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ethereum), SOL (Solana), XRP, HYP (Hyperliquid), DOGE (Dogecoin), LINK (Chainlink), AVAX (Avalanche), HBAR (Hedera), LTC (Litecoin), BNB, DOT (Polkadot) and SUI. Positive = inflow, negative = outflow. Use this for a quick dashboard snapshot. Flows are published one business day in arrears, so `referenceIsToday` is normally false: the figures belong to `referenceDate` — the last trading day published — and must not be described as today's. On Mondays the freshest data is Friday's. `totalUsdM` is already summed across all assets.
name: get_flows_summary
title: Latest Crypto ETF Flows
